name: Ti-6Al-4V Additive Manufacturing Melt Pool and Porosity Benchmark
description: Evaluates melt pool and keyhole dynamics, laser absorptance, and resulting porosity across additive manufacturing processing conditions for Ti-6Al-4V.
evaluation_method: task-dependent regression metrics (RMSE / MAE) and physics validation metrics for porosity/defect prediction
general_score_metric: RMSE (for continuous targets like porosity/melt-pool metrics)
notes: Experimental, domain-specific benchmark with noisy measurement data and high experimental cost to expand; small/expensive-to-collect datasets and strong sensitivity to experimental setup and instrumentation; not applicable to LLMs.
